note: Every quotation is Louis Segond 1910, pasted byte-for-byte by script where Segond says what the author quotes (mined), and rendered from the English where the author adapts, re-persons or blends a verse (self_rendered). Rows are the translators' per-quotation reports; every mined fragment was re-verified as a substring of both the Segond verse and the French chapter.
Verse numbers are cited as Segond numbers them (Psalm headings count as verse 1; Ecclesiastes 12 starts two verses earlier than the KJV). AI-translated in-session; awaiting native review.
